scheme_name: Mukyamantri Samuhik Vivah Evam Anudan Yojna
description:
The Mukyamantri Samuhik Vivah Evam Anudan Yojna is a significant welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Uttar Pradesh. 

This scheme was launched on June 1, 2016. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to promote mass marriages among economically disadvantaged sections of society. 

The government aims to provide financial assistance to families who cannot afford the expenses associated with marriage ceremonies. 

The scheme specifically targets the marriage of girls from families with limited financial resources. 

Under this scheme, the government provides a monetary assistance of ₹50,000 for each couple. 

This amount is intended to cover various expenses related to the marriage ceremony. 

The financial aid is provided directly to the bank account of the bride’s family. 

The scheme is designed to alleviate the financial burden on families during the marriage of their daughters. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are clearly defined. 

The bride must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh. 

The bride must be at least 18 years old at the time of marriage. 

The groom must be at least 21 years old at the time of marriage. 

The combined annual income of the bride’s family should not exceed ₹2 lakh. 

This income limit is set to ensure that the benefits reach the economically weaker sections of society. 

Families that have previously availed benefits under this scheme are not eligible for subsequent applications. 

The application process for the Mukyamantri Samuhik Vivah Evam Anudan Yojna is straightforward. 

Interested families must fill out the application form available at local government offices or online portals. 

The application form requires details such as the names of the bride and groom, their ages, and family income. 

Applicants must also provide proof of residence and income. 

Documents required include aadhar cards of the bride and groom, income certificates, and proof of residence. 

Once the application is completed, it must be submitted to the local district social welfare office. 

The application must be submitted at least 30 days prior to the scheduled date of the marriage. 

This timeline allows the authorities to process the application and disburse the funds in a timely manner. 

The disbursement of funds is typically done within a week after the marriage ceremony. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttar Pradesh. 

The district social welfare officers are responsible for overseeing the application process and fund disbursement. 

The scheme has seen significant uptake since its launch. 

In the first year alone, over 10,000 couples benefited from the scheme. 

By 2020, the number of beneficiaries had increased to over 50,000 couples. 

The government allocated a budget of ₹100 crore for the scheme in the financial year 2020-2021. 

This budget was aimed at expanding the reach of the scheme and supporting more families. 

The Mukyamantri Samuhik Vivah Evam Anudan Yojna also promotes social harmony. 

By facilitating mass marriages, the scheme encourages community participation. 

It helps in reducing the social stigma associated with marriages in economically weaker sections. 

The scheme has been well-received by the public. 

Many families have expressed gratitude for the financial assistance provided. 

The government has also organized mass marriage events to promote the scheme. 

These events not only provide financial assistance but also foster a sense of community. 

The scheme has been instrumental in reducing the financial stress associated with weddings. 

It encourages families to celebrate marriages without the burden of excessive costs. 

The Mukyamantri Samuhik Vivah Evam Anudan Yojna aligns with the government’s broader goals of women empowerment. 

By supporting the marriage of girls from economically weaker sections, the scheme promotes gender equality. 

It helps in ensuring that girls have the opportunity to marry without financial constraints. 

The scheme is part of a larger framework of welfare initiatives aimed at uplifting marginalized communities. 

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the impact of the scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the implementation process. 

The Mukyamantri Samuhik Vivah Evam Anudan Yojna is a crucial step towards ensuring social equity. 

It reflects the government's commitment to supporting vulnerable populations. 

The scheme also highlights the importance of community involvement in social welfare initiatives. 

Overall, the Mukyamantri Samuhik Vivah Evam Anudan Yojna serves as a vital resource for families in Uttar Pradesh. 

It provides essential financial support during a significant life event. 

The scheme not only addresses immediate financial needs but also contributes to long-term social change. 

By facilitating mass marriages, it helps in building stronger communities. 

The Mukyamantri Samuhik Vivah Evam Anudan Yojna is a commendable initiative by the Government of Uttar Pradesh. 

It stands as a testament to the state’s efforts in promoting social welfare and economic empowerment. 

The scheme continues to evolve and adapt to the needs of the population. 

It remains a beacon of hope for many families striving for a better future. 

The Mukyamantri Samuhik Vivah Evam Anudan Yojna exemplifies the power of government intervention in addressing social issues. 

It showcases the potential for positive change through targeted welfare programs. 

The scheme is a vital part of the social fabric of Uttar Pradesh. 

It is essential for ensuring that every girl has the opportunity to celebrate her marriage with dignity. 

The Mukyamantri Samuhik Vivah Evam Anudan Yojna is a significant step towards achieving this goal.
